mechanism: Nalmefene (opioid antagonist) may reduce carvedilol efficacy and both drugs can cause CNS depression; carvedilol metabolism via CYP2D6 may be affected by nalmefene's hepatic involvement.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; consider alternative beta-blocker if opioid antagonism is critical; ensure adequate seizure precautions as nalmefene lowers seizure threshold.
